controller.semantics: Read-only plan validation; never executes future handlers or authorizes calls.
controller.future_state: Separate execution receipts required after implementation instruction; no task is marked implemented by this program.

state_contract.blocked_means: No authorized ready work for this node and exact unmet prerequisite retained; not a successful dependency.
state_contract.skipped_means: Only unnecessary or ineligible recovery, or the expressly optional Catala branch, with a retained reason. Required generation cannot be skipped to complete full program.
state_contract.restart: Check process identity and receipt before dispatch; reuse authenticated completed results, retain failed attempts; changed dependencies invalidate reuse; never duplicate unknown external requests.
state_contract.reopening: Reopen a resolved BLOCKED task under its original ID and cumulative attempts. Changed input/output closure invalidates affected receipts; old results remain historical.
state_contract.success_semantics: SUCCEEDED means task-specific acceptance met on current inputs. G16 succeeds when a valid registered study is completed and assessed, even if all candidates are rejected; L19 success is accounting, not product success.

acceptance_inventory.limits: Families are case-writing obligations, not executed cases; exact case count is established at T03.

review_record.method: primary-agent source/code review and adverse local planning checks
